brief: Escalating US-Iran tanker strikes, five Iranian tankers destroyed and 8 oil tankers plus 2 US vessels hit in retaliation, took Brent above $100/bbl for the first time since July, closing 3.36% higher at $101.21, with the 6-month future at $86.09. Doubts Hormuz reopens soon, a fire and Ukrainian drone strikes on two gas condensate plants in Russia's Yamalo-Nenets gas hub took European gas futures 4.49% higher to €79.25/MWh, the highest since 2022. Higher energy costs fed hike pricing, the September Fed hike probability going from 61% to 63% and an extra +9.0bps of ECB hikes priced by June 2027 for 86bps total. Deutsche Bank says several asset classes are vulnerable to building inflation and faster tightening. That, plus a Treasury buyback of up to $6bn of longer-dated paper that fell short of estimates, lifted the 10yr Treasury to a post-2023 high of 4.84% and the 10yr bund to a post-2011 high of 3.44%, with multi-year highs in France, Italy, the UK, Australia and Japan. Equities fell, the S&P 500 down 0.48% for a third day and the STOXX 600 down 1.41%. The ECB is widely expected to hike 25bp to 2.5% today, and the BoJ's Masu said rate rises continue.
